$comment: Logical->actual role binding for the Fleet Intelligence app. Consumed by the Native App packaging step. synapse emits GRANTs against IDENTIFIER($<logical>_role); the operator remaps logical roles to real account roles here at install time. As of Step 3 all three bundles (user / ops / admin) are ACTIVE with their own MCP servers and (user/ops) Cortex Agents. Production role binding applied on wgb26798 (Phase 3E): FLEET_APP_USER / FLEET_APP_OPS / FLEET_APP_ADMIN.

user.description: End consumer: routing/optimization verbs + Cortex Analyst over the fleet semantic views. This is the ONLY bundle attached to the consumer Cortex Agent.

ops.description: Operations: service lifecycle (suspend/resume), active region, substrate health. Reachable via the role-gated FLEET_OPS_AGENT and the in-app Ops console (/api/ops). NOT attached to the consumer agent. Heavy provisioning (region/matrix builds, Data Studio) remains in the control app per the hybrid design.

admin.description: Installer: app install, agent creation, routing-substrate prereq checks, role binding. Reachable via the role-gated FLEET_ADMIN_AGENT and FLEET_ADMIN_MCP. NOT attached to the consumer agent.

substrate.$comment: Routing substrate is a provisioned prerequisite, not created by app install. Admin bundle verifies/links it.
